Hi, this is Brian Jungmin Park. 

This is my personal space for organizing my thoughts & exploring ideas around data science, ML, and AI. 

I keep notes on what I'm building, share experiments and useful discoveries, and occasionally write about interests beyond programming.

This site is a working notebook & a brief pause in between our weekdays. 


[Find me on GitHub](https://github.com/snowoflondon).

[Connect with me on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bjp/)

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages and built with Quarto.

The initial scaffolding was generated with Codex.

Every piece of *writing* here is written by me, unless specifically noted. 
As an avid writer, I believe in authoring content with no generative AI involved.
Of course, for AI projects & codebases, I will generate docs (READMEs, etc.), code (if appropriate)
, and reusable agent skills using LLMs. I typically use OpenAI's Codex. This will be noted.

My typical tech stack is: VS code + Python + Codex.
